verses.text: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered:
“How long are you going to keep hunting for words? Think it through first. Then we can talk.
Why do you count us as animals and see us as unclean?
You’re tearing yourself apart in anger. Should the earth be deserted for your sake? Should a rock be moved out of its place for you?
“Yes, the light of the wicked will go out. Not a spark from their fire will shine.
The light in their tent will go dark, and the lamp above them will go out.
Their once-powerful stride will get shorter, and their own plans will bring them down.
Their own feet will carry them into a net. They’ll walk straight into its mesh.
A snare will grab them by the heel. A trap will catch them.
A noose is hidden in the ground for them, and a trap is waiting on the path.
Terrors will scare them on every side and chase right at their heels.
Their strength will waste away, and disaster will be waiting right beside them.
Their body will be eaten away. Death’s firstborn will devour their limbs.
They’ll be ripped out of the safety of their tent and brought to the king of terrors.
What doesn’t belong to them will move into their tent. Sulfur will be scattered over their home.
Their roots will dry up below, and their branches will be cut off above.
Their memory will vanish from the earth. Nobody in the street will know their name.
They’ll be driven out of the light into darkness and chased out of the world.
They’ll have no son or grandson among their people, and no one will remain where they lived.
Those who come after will be stunned at what happened to them, just as those before were terrified.
That’s what happens to the homes of the unrighteous. That’s the place of someone who doesn’t know God.”
